messages.Import your own classic .wsz main-panel: Import your own classic .wsz main-panel artwork. Native text and shared playback controls; no scripts, plugins, modern .wal skins or separate EQ/playlist windows.
messages.Independent client · Not affiliated with: Independent client · Not affiliated with TIDAL · No DRM bypass
messages.Independent native Rust client. Not affi: Independent native Rust client. Not affiliated with TIDAL.
messages.Keyring protection depends on your deskt: Keyring protection depends on your desktop provider. Configure and unlock its default collection before migration; this app never opens automatic unlock prompts.
messages.Local to this account on this device; no: Local to this account on this device; nothing is uploaded to TIDAL. Turning recording off keeps existing entries. Muted playback counts; pauses, seeks and buffering do not.
messages.Local to this account. Nothing is upload: Local to this account. Nothing is uploaded to TIDAL.
messages.Lossless is preferred; authorized AAC/HE: Lossless is preferred; authorized AAC/HE-AAC remains supported. Encrypted audio and DRM circumvention are not supported.
messages.Managed installations should be updated: Managed installations should be updated through Home Manager, not an in-app updater.

messages.Native output server unavailable. No aut: Native output server unavailable. No automatic switch to compatibility output.

messages.Only uniquely named root folders are lis: Only uniquely named root folders are listed. Rename duplicates before choosing a destination.

messages.Playback and Now Playing remain availabl: Playback and Now Playing remain available. No other lyrics service was contacted.
messages.Positions refer to Original order, not a: Positions refer to Original order, not a filtered or sorted view.
messages.Prefer lossless · AAC fallback when unav: Prefer lossless · AAC fallback when unavailable
messages.Private account-scoped player-state.json: Private account-scoped player-state.json files retain the queue, position, volume and last page. Signing out removes credentials, but leaves these playback snapshots for your next sign-in.
messages.RGB colors, 0–255. All text colors must: RGB colors, 0–255. All text colors must meet 4.5:1 contrast on every surface. Invalid palettes leave the current appearance unchanged.
messages.Read remaining album pages, up to 50,000: Read remaining album pages, up to 50,000 entries. Unavailable entries still count toward pagination. Does not change playback; an in-flight page may finish after stopping.
messages.Read the remaining playlist pages for fi: Read the remaining playlist pages for filtering and sorting. Does not change playback. Limited to 50,000 playlist entries.
messages.Read the remaining saved items, up to 50: Read the remaining saved items, up to 50,000 entries. Does not change playback or favorites. Changes made elsewhere may require Refresh; an in-flight page may finish after stopping.
messages.Real audio, colored by the artwork. Clic: Real audio, colored by the artwork. Click empty space in the bottom bar to cycle modes. Volume does not affect the display.
messages.Recording is off by default. Disabling k: Recording is off by default. Disabling keeps existing records; Clear deletes them. Signing out retains this account's local history.
messages.Recording stays on; future listening can: Recording stays on; future listening can add new records.
messages.Removal can only be verified from a comp: Removal can only be verified from a complete library response. Large or incomplete libraries may require manual inspection.
messages.Restored loaded data for this account. R: Restored loaded data for this account. Refresh for the latest changes.

messages.Right-click (or Shift+F10 on a focused r: Right-click (or Shift+F10 on a focused row) to rename folders or move playlists.
messages.Right-to-left text retained; complex-scr: Right-to-left text retained; complex-script font/shaping support is not yet verified.
